expressions.en: To troubleshoot / To fix (a technical issue)
expressions.cn: 排除故障/修复 (技术问题)
开发/构建 (应用程序/系统)
数字化 / 走向数字化

work.scenario: Your team is preparing to launch a new internal project management system next month. You need to ensure all user data is transferred correctly and troubleshoot any integration issues before the launch.

life.scenario: You're trying to use a banking app on your phone, but it keeps crashing after a recent update. You need to figure out how to fix it or report the problem to customer service.

tech.scenario: Your company is undergoing a major digital transformation, developing a new e-commerce platform. The development team needs to continuously analyze user behavior data to optimize the platform and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.
